image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage-style wall-mounted barometer. The instrument features a brass or gold-colored metal casing with an elongated vertical shape. At the bottom is a circular dial with a white face, black markings, and a pointer hand. Above the dial is a smaller, secondary circular window or thermometer housing, also with a metallic rim. The background is a plain, out-of-focus beige wall.
